tool_args.rationale: Fit the recalled sink-gradient law to the seven observations and request fresh confirmation. All observed gradients are below the stated avalanche threshold, so its strength and threshold are unidentifiable from these rows; their fitted values remain dependent on initialization until high-gradient observations are available.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The gradient-varying probe supports the recalled saturating sink-gradient mechanism over mechanisms lacking its specific gradient dependence.
The observed ambiguity concerns the unobserved high-gradient branch, not trajectory resolution; this probe is not identified as targeting that branch.
It would identify the avalanche branch, but it is not in the available probe menu.
